module: Synchronous core of lua-websockets: extend(obj) adds to an object having sock_send, sock_receive, sock_close (and sock_connect on the client side) the methods connect, send, receive and close. Handles the handshake, reassembly of fragmented messages, automatic reply to PINGs (client) and clean closing. Used by client_sync, client_copas and server_copas.
notes: extend raises an assertion if the object already has receive, send, close, connect or is_closing.
receive returns (nil, nil, was_clean, code, reason) on close; otherwise (message, opcode).
In receive, the error message 'frame was not masked' is emitted when a frame received on the client side IS masked (message inverted relative to the condition).
For 'wss', connect calls self:dohandshake; with client_sync, ssl is nil so this fails.

extend.desc: Adds the WebSocket methods to obj and initializes obj.state to 'CLOSED' if absent.

obj.desc: Object with sock_send, sock_receive, sock_close (and sock_connect if it is not a server).
Object extended by extend. Fields: state ('CLOSED', 'OPEN'), is_server, is_closing, optional on_close callback.

connect.desc: Client connection: parses the URL, connects the socket, performs the HTTP handshake and checks Sec-WebSocket-Accept. Sets state to 'OPEN' on success.

send.desc: Sends a message (masked if the object is not a server). Closes the connection if the send fails.

returns.desc: true if sent; nil, was_clean, code, reason otherwise.

receive.desc: Blocks until a complete message is received. Reassembles fragments, replies to PINGs on the client side, replies to CLOSE with an echo.

close.desc: Sends a CLOSE frame, waits for the reply, closes the socket, calls on_close if it exists and sets state to 'CLOSED'. Returns false if the state is not 'OPEN'.
